feeds.title: Divorce Minister
feeds.description: I write this blog to be a resource to break the silence on a much misunderstood issue in the evangelical church as well as to support those who have experienced a spouse's infidelity and/or divorce.

feeds.title: Divorced Girl Smiling
feeds.description: Divorced Girl Smiling is a divorce blog designed to offer advice and inspiration to people thinking about divorce, going through a divorce or dating after divorce.

feeds.title: Life-Saving Divorce
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Gretchen Baskerville. I'm a Christian in the Los Angeles area who has been doing Christian divorce recovery ministry in churches since 1998. As you can imagine, I've heard many many heartbreaking stories of betrayal and abuse. For Christians whose marriages ended due to sexual immorality, physical or emotional abuse, or other serious reasons.

feeds.title: Law and Mediation Offices of Kelly Chang Blog
feeds.description: We consider ourselves among the blessed, for we truly love our work. This is because we know our purpose, and we were gifted with the ability to achieve that purpose. We try the best results for you and your family. This is our purpose as your lawyers. We are proud of our work, and we strive to never take our clients' trust for granted.

feeds.title: Midlife Divorce Recovery
feeds.description: The Midlife Divorce Recovery divorce recovery blog focuses on the topics, issues, and problems affecting women who get divorced later in life. Follow these articles that will help you get over your divorce and join the MDR community!

feeds.title: Surviving The Pain Of Divorce
feeds.description: This blog is all about surviving an unwanted separation and divorce.

feeds.title: Since My Divorce
feeds.description: Mandy Walker is a divorce coach who went through a divorce of her own. Her blog provides advice about many facets of divorce, including emotional and legal challenges. She also has a great Story Catalog, which includes a large collection of stories about men, women, and children who experienced divorces. They offer unique perspectives that are not regularly found on other sites about divorce.

feeds.title: Peace after Divorce Blog
feeds.description: Peace after Divorce was first launched in 2011 by author and educator, Renee Ettline. The longstanding mission of this Christian workshop curriculum is to offer love and healing to those hurting from divorce.

feeds.title: Men's Divorce Recovery Blog
feeds.description: Men's Divorce Recovery (MDR) is a ministry that began in 2016 after its CEO and founder, Dale J. Brown went through his own divorce following 32 years of marriage. Convinced that every man who is divorced can experience God's love and transformation, Dale launched MDR to help men find God's plan for them during the second half of their life.

feeds.title: Christian Connection Blog » Divorce
feeds.description: Christian Connection is an award-winning Christian dating website in the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, USA, and Canada. In the divorce, section get dating & relationship advice, and articles on singleness, marriage, and happiness from Christian Connection.

feeds.title: Divorce to Healing Blog
feeds.description: Divorce to Healing Blog is for those affected in any way by divorce and are in the process of healing. No matter where you are in the healing process, you will find these words worthy of your time and acceptance.

feeds.title: The Christian Girl's Guide to Divorce
feeds.description: The Christian Girl's Guide to Divorce is Leslie Spencer's achingly honest journey through love and loss, joy and sorrow, pain and laughter, and, most importantly, God's faithfulness.

feeds.title: Grace for the Gray Spaces Blog
feeds.description: Grace for the Gray Spaces is a humble effort to acknowledge the complications of life with a Christ-centered worldview. If you're discovering how to live this beautiful life amidst the soul-crushing disappointments that are inevitable in a fallen world, I hope you'll find some encouragement
